title: Two queue fixes — preview before implementation

steps.path: Send a message when Claude is ready
steps.headline: 1. Immediate sends no longer flash a queue row.
steps.changed: Keep internal delivery tracking, but show the existing queue strip only for genuinely waiting or unconfirmed messages. No delay or debounce hides real waiting.
steps.notice: A ready-to-send message goes straight to the conversation without a temporary Sending row. Real waiting messages keep their existing controls.
steps.risk: This is a posed delivery snapshot, not a timing test; delivery classification and backend behavior are not implemented yet.

steps.path: An old Unconfirmed message above the message box
steps.headline: 2. An unconfirmed message can be dismissed without sending it again.
steps.changed: Add Dismiss… beside the existing delivery-check control. It opens a confirmation instead of canceling, editing or resending an unknown delivery.
steps.notice: Only the saved queue message is removed after confirmation. The conversation is unchanged, and sending stays blocked when safe cleanup has not been confirmed.
steps.risk: UI-only fixture: no journal, lease or native message box is changed by this preview.

steps.headline: 2a. The confirmation warns that the message may already have been delivered.
steps.changed: Reuse Rename session's one-job card and the app's destructive confirmation buttons: Dismiss without resending, then Keep message. Escape and the × leave it alone.
steps.notice: The warning separates removing the queue record from proving the message box is safe. Dismiss never replays the message and does not resume the queue.
steps.risk: The preview removes only a fixture row; real dismissal needs a durable non-replay resolution after approval.

steps.path: Confirm Dismiss without resending while cleanup is unproven
steps.headline: 2b. Dismissal does not unlock an unsafe message box.
steps.changed: Replace the removed Unconfirmed row with the existing error notice. The message box stays disabled until classified cleanup proves it safe.
steps.notice: The notice says sending is still blocked and offers Diagnose, not Resume or Resend. Other waiting messages stay saved and cannot drain while unsafe.
steps.risk: Diagnose and cleanup are not wired in this UI preview; it makes no promise that dismissing an old message can restore sending.
